purpose: Test the research effect-receipt adapter's normal-completion owner lifecycle path while retaining the existing recovered-action path.
hypothesis: A normal completed action may qualify for effect-timing attribution only when its exact public result lookup binds the dispatch, verified release, and neutral late-input horizon; missing custody must fail closed.
treatment: Synthetic recorded dispatch + interface_results + independent task-score ledger + before/after captures; effect interval after completion horizon.

acceptance.positive_control: post-expiry/post-horizon factual success preserved but ineligible
acceptance.timing_order: release may precede lease expiry on normal completion; success eligibility still ends at expiry
acceptance.regression: existing recovered-action tests continue to pass

not_claimed: live GUI or native input behavior
